name: LORATADINE / BETAMETHASONE 100/5 MG SOLUTION 60 ML 1 PIECE
description: Active Ingredients: Loratadine (antihistamine) and Betamethasone (corticosteroid). Presentation: Generally found in a box containing 10 tablets. Indications: Used for the relief of inflammatory and pruritic (itching) symptoms characteristic of various allergic conditions, such as: Seasonal and perennial allergic rhinitis. Atopic and contact dermatitis. Urticaria (hives). Angioedema (swelling). Allergic asthma. Mechanism of Action: Loratadine blocks histamine receptors to relieve allergy symptoms, while betamethasone reduces inflammation and calms the immune system. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
